_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.

says.meet: The 3 of us will be giving out winner medals tomorrow so if you think you're good enough now come back tomorrow and try and beat us!
says.repeat: If you can beat all 3 of us tomorrow you can enter the gym leader challenge!

says.meet: Hoh Hoh, I imagine you're new in town ey? I'm Hamish one of the the 3 Card Elders in town. If you beat all 3 of us in a match we will grant you access to the Gym Hero Challenge. However... Because it's the bank holiday weekend we're having the day off!
says.repeat: Thanks to the Bank Holiday, there are no more trains to this station for the rest of the day. The market is also shut so the plazas will be quite quiet until tomorrow.

says.meet: I work at the station but I'm just on my break.
says.repeat: I'm not a big card player otherwise I'd be watching the Elders.

says.meet: I'm been tasked with litter picking with the influx of tourist.
says.repeat: There's plenty of bins around so I don't why people don't use them.

says.meet: Mmmmmmmmmm............ Have you tried the juice here? Freshly squeezed, straight from the fruit and chilled to perfection.
says.repeat: ...... Nothing beats an ice cold delicious juice on the beach!

says.meet: I'm so glad we moved here. It smells like freshly cut grass and warm sea air every day here.
says.repeat: My husband is so kind and generous, we've already made a lot of great friends here.

says.meet: I managed pick up a new coin from the shopkeeper over there. It was super expensive but I absolutely love visiting Galar so I had to have a little wooloo.
says.repeat: Can you believe that over in Galar Wooloo just wander around in the open? I think I wish we had those over here but I guess the weather is too warm for them.

says.meet: I'm so stupid! I came to Market Plaza to pick up a new coin, but I forgot it's a bank holiday so of course it's shut!!
says.repeat: I'll have to come back tomorrow, I've been using the same coin for so long I'm desperate for a new one!

says.meet: Hello! I'm getting my daily steps in like I do every day, but I decided to do it on the beach instead today.
says.repeat: The sand is much harder to walk on but it's nice being next to the ocean.

says.meet: Do you ever end up walking more than you thought you were going to?
says.repeat: I always end up walking further than I should.

says.meet: Hello! Nice to meet you, I live in the neighbourhood at number 11. I've just going for my morning walk to get my daily steps in!
says.repeat: How is the harbour treating you? My parents have lived here since before I was born so I'm sure we'll bump into each other again!

says.meet: I managed to walk 20,000 steps today I'm absolutely worn out.
says.repeat: I think I walked a bit too far today.

says.meet: Hey watch yourself there, I'm doing some work on this ship here and I don't want you to get electrocuted or anything.
says.repeat: Please be careful around the docks, don't get too close to the edge.

says.meet: I'll be done with this work very soon, I'm just finishing the last bit of welding on the hull.
says.repeat: Watch yourself around these ships, it can be dangerous if you're not careful.

says.meet: Plants can grow in all weird shapes and sizes, they're not just flowers and trees, there's a lot of different kinds out there.
says.repeat: I've catalogued a lot of crazy plants recently.
says.first_win: I wish I could photosynthesize.
says.rematch_win: I could do with some water
says.loss: Grass Pokemon are great!

says.meet: Heh you want to try and beat me kid??
says.repeat: Damn... they're gonna kick me out of the cool guy biker gang for this.
says.first_win: Heh you're pretty tough, you wanna join our gang?
says.rematch_win: Now they're DEFINITELY going to kick me out of the cool guy biker gang...
says.loss: Heh heh heh, too easy.

says.meet: I caught these bad looking dudes heading to the forest and they gave me some interesting cards and went on their way.
says.repeat: I won't lost this time.
says.first_win: You even seen a Dark Pokemon before?
says.rematch_win: I need some more of these Dark cards.
says.loss: You didn't stand a chance.

says.meet: This beach is a great spot to train both my martial arts and my card skills.
says.repeat: Want to join in with my training?
says.first_win: A loss is always a good chance to improve.
says.rematch_win: I'm going to keep on training.
says.loss: I rarely lose when I've trained properly.

says.meet: I heard there's a scary Pokemon called Sandyghast. They sound scary and I don't like scary Pokemon, I only like cute pokemon!!
says.repeat: Yes let's play again!
says.first_win: You haven't seen a Sandyghast have you?
says.rematch_win: If you see a Sandyghast please let me know!!
says.loss: Yaaaaaay! I won!!

says.meet: I hope mummy brings us back to the beach to play again tomorrow.
says.repeat: We normally come to the beach every day to play!

says.meet: I love the beach! I love the sand! I love building sandcastles! I love playing the Pokemon TCG!
says.repeat: I could build sandcastles and play Pokemon all day!
says.first_win: Please don't destroy my sandcastles!!!
says.rematch_win: You can help me build a sandcastle if you want!
says.loss: Yaaaaaay! I love winning!

says.meet: Mum said it's nearly bedtime so we have to go home soon.
says.repeat: I wish we could stay and play all day.

says.meet: My friend said this is a great spot to find them but also a great spot to battle.
says.repeat: This really is a great spot for birds and cards!
says.first_win: Do you hate birds or something?.
says.rematch_win: Well at least I can watch the birds from around here.
says.loss: Looking after birds really isn't easy!

says.meet: These Palms attract a lot of Bird Pokemon so its a good spot to watch them.
says.repeat: Looking for more Birds round here?
says.first_win: I wish I could just fly away.
says.rematch_win: You can't fly away from all your troubles.
says.loss: You should try bird watching with me!

says.meet: Some people hate bugs but I love them! Do you love bugs too?
says.repeat: You just love bugs as much as I do then?
says.first_win: Maybe bugs aren't as good as I thought...
says.rematch_win: Me and my bugs will win one of these days!
says.loss: I knew bugs were the best!!

says.meet: Wow!!! The bugs here are so much cooler than what we have over in Viridian Forest!!
says.repeat: Seen any cool bug Pokemon around here since our last match?
says.first_win: My bugs clearly aren't as strong as the ones around here.
says.rematch_win: Hmm I wish I could get my hands on some of these bugs instead.
says.loss: Bug pokemon really aren't as weak as people think.

says.meet: Back for the challenge then hey? Remember you'll need to defeat all 3 of us if you want to progress.
says.repeat: Very well, I always enjoy a good challenge!
says.first_win: Well done, that was quite the battle. Take my medal and continue forth.
says.rematch_win: Battling like this makes me feel young again.
says.loss: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

says.meet: We're not as young as we used to be but we're still the best in the harbour. If you're looking to take on the Gym Hero Challenge you're better off coming back tomorrow when there are less people waiting, otherwise you'll be stood around all day. This card might help your chances.
says.repeat: You might need to buy a few more packs from the Card Mart first too. A lot of people are generous to give cards away so make sure you speak to everyone around too.

says.meet: Hoh Hoh, are you ready to feel the torrent? If you win I'll give you a medal to prove your triumph.
says.repeat: Hoh Hoh! I enjoyed the battle that much I'd also like another!
says.first_win: Congratulations on your win. You've earned this medal and my respect.
says.rematch_win: Come back any time and battle us old folk.
says.loss: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

says.meet: Hoh Hoh, are you looking to enter the Gym Hero Challenge? If you beat all 3 of us Elders we will grant you permission! .....However I'm already flat out with all these tourists. Take this card for now and come back tomorrow instead when it's quieter
says.repeat: You might need some better cards if you have a hope of beating us, make sure you've visited the card mart today and also check out card vendor at the market if you haven't already.

says.meet: Are you ready to take me on then? If you win then you'll do well in the Gym Hero Challenge.
says.repeat: Up for another round then? Happy to oblige.
says.first_win: Well well well, what a jolly good play! You've earned this.
says.rematch_win: We've been winning and losing for so long it's always fun either way.
says.loss: When you fail, get up and try again.

says.meet: Hold on there sonny boy, with the SS Anne, you've arrived a bit too late! There's a lot of people already in the queue, by the looks of things it'll take us all day to get through this lot but it should be quieter tomorrow so take this card to help with your patience.
says.repeat: Make sure you've earned as many cards as you can around here, you'll need them to defeat us 3.

says.meet: As you can see, the new bulb installation went perrrrfectly today. I'm worn out from all the steps but always game for a match.
says.repeat: I won't be needing to replace the bulb any time soon so I've got time to kill.
says.first_win: That was clearly toooooo many steps today.
says.rematch_win: At least I'm reaaallly good at replacing bulbs.
says.loss: I hope your loss didn't come as a shock to you.

says.meet: Hey, I've been working hard all day so I'm ready to play
says.repeat: It's rare I have to work at night so I'm free for another match.
says.first_win: I simply cannot fix that at all.
says.rematch_win: I'm going to weld my cards at this rate.
says.loss: You just need to work harder

says.meet: I've been breathing that much fire that I needed an ice cold bev to cool my mouth down, but I'm ready for a match if you want.
says.repeat: I'm fired up and ready for another match if you want.
says.first_win: I burned out too quick.
says.rematch_win: I could teach you how to firebreath... but maybe you should teach me how to play cards better!
says.loss: That juice was just what I needed!

says.meet: I've been breathing that much fire that I needed an ice cold bev to cool my mouth down.
says.repeat: My mouth has been royally singed so I can't even taste the juice.

says.meet: mMMMmm mMmMm MmmmMM MmMMmM mMMMmMmMm mMmMmMMm MMMmM mm mmMM MmmMMmM.
says.repeat: Sorry you caught me at a bad time I had a mouthful of fire fluid there.

says.meet: I'm so used to hot drinks that it's weird to drink something nice and cold.
says.repeat: If you want another match then let's goooooo.
says.first_win: I have too many burns to battle well.
says.rematch_win: I'll just stick to the firebreathing from now on, I'm good at that.
says.loss: Can't burn me out!

says.meet: I'm so used to hot drinks that it's weird to drink something nice and cold.
says.repeat: Have you tried the juice yet?

says.meet: We're good at what we do and we make it look easy but it's not.
says.repeat: It's very hard work this!

says.meet: I love the lighthouse here, it seems to attract all kinds of fish so I always catch a lot in this spot. I'm catching so many I need a break.
says.repeat: I've caught a lot since last time.
says.first_win: Even if they don't help me win, I still love my fish.
says.rematch_win: Fishing and Pokemon cards are both a lot of fun, I could do both all day.
says.loss: Maybe you should try picking up a rod and give fishing a go instead!

says.meet: I joined my buddies here to fish today but we were actually catching sooo much that they ended up leaving!
says.repeat: Fishing by yourslef can get lonely when nothing bites.
says.first_win: Dang, I never lose against my buddies.
says.rematch_win: You're probably a really good fisherman too.
says.loss: I'm the only fisherman and best card player on this pier!

says.meet: Me and my buddy Dave fish here all the time. The lighthouse is like a giant lure in the evening so we catch even more. I've got time for a break.
says.repeat: The evening is still young if you want another match.
says.first_win: I'm a much better fisherman than I am a card player.
says.rematch_win: Always happy to put my fishing aside for a rematch.
says.loss: I'm not just the best round here at fishing!

says.meet: All I need is a bit of luck, I let that decide my fate. If I battle enough then I'm bound to win some of them at least.
says.repeat: I'll be a lot luckier this time round.
says.first_win: Luck really wasn't on my side today...
says.rematch_win: I just need a little bit of luck that's all.
says.loss: Looks like luck wasn't on your side today.

says.meet: I might be the garden manager but I do know how to have fun.
says.repeat: Look at how great the gardens look.
says.first_win: Even with all this sun I couldn't win.
says.rematch_win: Ever fancied being a gardener yourself?
says.loss: Plants aren't just pretty.

says.meet: Wowee, it was a long day gardening today. I'm down for a match to let off some steam now.
says.repeat: I've got time for a rematch before my next shift.
says.first_win: I'm clearly too worn out from such a long shift.
says.rematch_win: I'll win when I'm fully rested.
says.loss: Even after a hard days work I can still win!

says.meet: We're the Toxtricity Rockers, we're a duo that's pretty big in Johto.
says.repeat: You here to hear a song or a rematch?
says.first_win: I missed a chord.
says.rematch_win: Fancy being a roadie?
says.loss: If it's any consolation I'll give you a discount on our album.

says.meet: We're in a band and we're currently touring. We're just passing through to our next gig so having a quick jam here.
says.repeat: Hey dude, let's rock.
says.first_win: Damn I snapped a string while we were jamming.
says.rematch_win: You should come to one of our gigs!
says.loss: Let's goooooooooooo.

says.meet: Well that's incredibly disappointing. I was hoping to have a trek through the forest but they've told me it's shut so I have nowhere to go now.
says.repeat: The forest has to be open soon surely.
says.first_win: Well that's another disappointment to my day.
says.rematch_win: The disappointment just doesn't end.
says.loss: At least that's given me a nice little boost after the bad news.

says.meet: I've been hiking for hours and only just managed to reach the harbour and found everything is closed so now I have nothing to do for the evening.
says.repeat: I'll be hiking back again tomorrow, I hike all day every day!
says.first_win: I should have just called it a night...
says.rematch_win: I could do with a long hike to get over this loss.
says.loss: I'm as solid as stone!

says.meet: I've been training for my marathon all day so I'm worn out, I've ran over 30km today alone.
says.repeat: I'm still taking a break before heading home.
says.first_win: I've ran far too much today I should have just rested.
says.rematch_win: I'm just going to focus on my running from now on.
says.loss: I'm glad I decided to take a break, that's given me an extra push to carry on.

says.meet: The evening sun is the most perfect time to come here and paint... or play cards!
says.repeat: I've been painting a lot of great pieces from this spot.
says.first_win: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
says.rematch_win: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
says.loss: To win is a beautiful piece of art.

says.meet: I'm here on bosses orders but we're not starting until tomorrow so you'll be good practice.
says.repeat: I'm not really a bad guy but I can't let people know that.
says.first_win: Oh no, don't tell the boss.
says.rematch_win: I'm gonna be toast.
says.loss: Ha ha, you didn't put up much of a fight.

says.meet: Team Rocket used to be the most feared group in the world. Maybe we will be again.
says.repeat: Have you ever heard of us before?
says.first_win: Weren't you even a little bit scared?
says.rematch_win: I really gotta act more scary.
says.loss: If you didn't already you should definitely fear us now.

says.meet: I'm all done preparing for the arrival of the SS Anne so there's not much to do now until morning.
says.repeat: There's still time before the SS Anne arrives.
says.first_win: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock.
says.rematch_win: I won't have a lot of time to play when the ship docks.
says.loss: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice.

says.meet: I'm going to busy until this evening now the SS Anne has docked. There were even more passengers than I initially thought there would be.
says.repeat: I wonder what Vermillion city is like? It's crazy to see so many Pokemon trainers in one place, barely anyone is a Pokemon trainer around here.

says.meet: I'm going to busy until this evening now the SS Anne has docked. There were even more passengers than I initially thought there would be.
says.repeat: I wonder what Vermillion city is like? It's crazy to see so many Pokemon trainers in one place, barely anyone is a Pokemon trainer around here.

says.meet: I'm just finishing the final preparations for the arrival of the SS Anne tomorrow, there isn't much to do so I'll be done by tonight free.
says.repeat: The arrival of the SS Anne has been a big deal around here, It's coming straight from Vermillion city so should be packed full of Pokemon trainers.

says.meet: I'm trying out some new techniques using statuses. If we battle I'll show you how good they are.
says.repeat: I'll definitely win this time round.
says.first_win: Oh man I really thought my statuses were going to cause you some trouble.
says.rematch_win: Maybe I need a better tactic...
says.loss: I knew my status infliction technique would work!

says.meet: I love the water, it's so calm and warm but my cards always get wet! I need to dry them off.
says.repeat: My friend has just arrived from Kanto and we're spending the day swimming together, but I can take a break for a rematch.
says.first_win: I'll stick with my swimming...
says.rematch_win: Nothing like a good match and a long swim.
says.loss: Maybe you should work on your swimming...

says.meet: The sea is so much calmer and warmer here than it is back home in Kanto.
says.repeat: I could stay in the water here all day.
says.first_win: I wish they made cards waterproof...
says.rematch_win: I really need to dry off my cards.
says.loss: I'm glad I came here today!

says.meet: I'm training for a Quadrathlon. It's a 1000m Swim, Bike, Run and then 100 TCG matches!
says.repeat: I'm still training super hard.
says.first_win: I can swim really well, maybe I should train using my deck more than swimming.
says.rematch_win: At least my swimming is going really well.
says.loss: I am so ready for this event.
